subject: Replace SE-II (R. Mendoza) — level/band recommendation & offer cap
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Replace SE-II (R. Mendoza) — level/band recommendation & offer cap

Hi team,

Rafael Mendoza (SE-II, Platform Infra) handed in his resignation effective 4/30. He owns the data-migration piece of the streaming infra work and has been taking on some IC3-level design/ownership over the last 6 months. Given the scope and risk of the upcoming migration I recommend we replace him with an IC3 (SE-III) rather than a straight IC2 replacement.

Recommendation summary:
- Headcount: refill 1 FTE (replace Rafael) as SE-III (IC3)
- Proposed base: $150,000 — $170,000 (target $165,000)
- Total comp: target ~ $190k (base + equity + bonus)
- Rationale: sustained ownership of cross-team migration, on-call escalation, and mentoring two junior engineers.

Attachments: comp-band-2026-q2.pdf (band ranges), headcount-replacement-request-20260405.pdf (filled form).

Ask: expedite approval today if possible. We need to post by next week to avoid a >6 week gap in coverage. If approved, I'll let TalentPros know we can extend an offer up to $170k base (with sign-off), otherwise we'll advertise at midpoint and pursue internal candidates.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Sr Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

---

[Attachment stubs]
- comp-band-2026-q2.pdf (PDF, 124 KB)
- headcount-replacement-request-20260405.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Replace SE-II (R. Mendoza) — level/band recommendation & offer cap

Laura —

Thanks for the write-up. A couple quick asks before I OK anything:
1) Can you include a short justification (2–3 bullets) on why the role should be IC3 instead of a standard IC2 backfill? I want to capture the business/technical risk.
2) What are the budget implications for the team this quarter? If we move the band up, does it require reallocation from another headcount or is there slack in the FY26 hiring plan?
3) Any candidates internally who could step into the responsibilities short-term (0–3 months) to reduce risk? If yes, let's consider a temporary internal transfer + external backfill plan.

If we can't keep the headcount in the same budget, I'd prefer capping offers at the band midpoint (~$155k) and using the escalation path for exceptional hires. If you can answer the three items above I can sign off on up to $165k base; anything above needs Priya + exec approval.

-Marcus
VP, Engineering Ops
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Apr 5, 2026 at 09:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rafael Mendoza (SE-II, Platform Infra) handed in his resignation effective 4/30...

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2026 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Replace SE-II (R. Mendoza) — level/band recommendation & offer cap

Hi Marcus —

Answers inline:
1) IC3 justification (short):
   - Rafael has been the de facto owner for the streaming data migration for the last 3 releases (designed the fallback, led postmortems). The role requires independent design and cross-team negotiation that goes beyond an IC2 scope.
   - The migration has live-customer impact; we need someone who can run design reviews and sign-off without heavy PD involvement.
   - Expectation is 6–9 months of owning the feature end-to-end; a junior hire would require 30–40% more oversight.

2) Budget impact:
   - Current team hiring budget has ~$120k of slack for Q2 (leftover from paused contractor FTE). Filling at $165k will use ~45% of that slack; hiring at $170k requires pulling $10–15k from another open req.
   - If we push to IC4, we'd need explicit headcount reuse or an additional hire freeze in another squad.

3) Internal coverage:
   - I checked with Evelyn Hart — she’s stretched and can't transfer. Dev Patel expressed interest in stepping in as interim lead for 6–8 weeks but would leave his current project unfilled (costly). Not recommended as a direct transfer.

Recommendation: Approve posting as IC3, authorize offers up to $170k base conditional on Priya/Comp sign-off. Given the impact, paying at top-of-band for a short window is defensible.

If Marcus is comfortable approving up to $165k I can move immediately; otherwise I'll wait for Priya's final sign-off for $170k.

Thanks,
Laura

Thanks all — reviewed the comp band and the headcount request. People Ops approves the refill as an IC3 with the following constraints:

- Authorization: offers up to $170,000 base are approved for this role (total comp discretion still applies).
- Any offer >$170k requires an executive exception (Comp Committee sign-off).
- Please use the standard hire packet and include the comp-band PDF in the candidate materials.
- Priya will notify recruiting to proceed with TalentPros (sarah@talentpros.com) and will provision the DocuSign template.

Next steps:
- Laura: post the req with IC3 title and target comp of $165k, indicate offer authorization to $170k in the internal approval field.
- Marcus: if you still want a hard cap at $165k, let us know; otherwise Priya will route the approval and recruiting will proceed.

Approvals recorded here: https://redwood-internal.docs/hc-requests/HR-2043
DocuSign (offer template): https://app.docusign.com/ABCDEF123456

Thanks —
